sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.prompt_hint: Write a formal introduction covering purpose, scope, key terms and how this document is organised.

sections.title: 2. Overall Description
sections.prompt_hint: Describe the product context, major functions, intended users, constraints, and assumptions.

sections.title: 3. Specific Requirements
sections.prompt_hint: Enumerate all specific requirements with unique IDs (e.g. SRS-F-001). Use SHALL for mandatory requirements.

sections.title: 4. Verification
sections.prompt_hint: Describe how each requirement category will be verified (inspection, analysis, test).

sections.title: 5. Appendices
sections.prompt_hint: Include any supporting information: data models, process flows, glossary.
